text.p: Scores on the third day of four-day English county championship cricket matches on Saturday:

At Derby: Warwickshire beat Derbyshire by four wickets. Derbyshire 242 and 255 (T.O'Gorman 66), Warwickshire 231 and 270-6 (T.Penney 83 not out, A.Giles 67 not out). Warwickshire 21 points, Derbyshire 5.
At Northampton: Lancashire 356 and 226-5 (G.Lloyd 70, J.Crawley 58), Northamptonshire 471 (K.Curran 93, M.Loye 90, K.Innes 63, T.Walton 52; R.Green 4-78)
At Worcester: Gloucestershire 334 and 236-8 (M.Lynch 72; T.Moody 5-78), Worcestershire 319 (D.Leatherdale 70, G.Hick 54; C.Walsh 5-64)

At Uxbridge: Somerset 485 (P.Holloway 168, R.Turner 75, K.Parsons 72) and 211-3 (P.Holloway 68 not out, K.Parsons 59 not out), Middlesex 350-3 declared (P.Weekes 171 not out, O.Shah 75, K.Brown 56 not out)
At Cardiff: Glamorgan 364 and 218-3 (S.James 84 not out, P.Cottey 64 not out), Surrey 471-9 declared (N.Shahid 79, G.Thorpe 77, M.Bicknell 59 not out, C.Lewis 57, A.Hollioake 51).
At Canterbury: Kent 445 and 211 (S.Marsh 55; S.Renshaw 4-75), Hampshire 358 (J.Laney 105, R.Smith 60, A.Aymes 52; D.Headley 5-83, M.Ealham 4-73).
At Chelmsford: Sussex 363 (A.Wells 122, I.Salisbury 70, N.Lenham 55) and 335-8 (V.Drakes 105, W.Athey 74), Essex 360 (G.Gooch 82, S.Law 64; R.Kirtley 4-94).
